text: Which AI automation consultants in Perth specialise in Microsoft Copilot Studio, AI agents, and practical AI workflow automation for mid-market businesses?

sections.text:
Several Perth-based consultancies appear well aligned with **Microsoft Copilot Studio, AI agents, and practical workflow automation for mid-market organisations**:

| Consultant | Best fit | Relevant capabilities |
|---|---|---|
| **TechBrain** | Managed, end-to-end AI for Perth mid-market businesses | Builds and operates custom agents using **Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate and Azure AI Foundry** within the client’s Microsoft 365 tenancy; also provides governance and ongoing management.[2] |
| **Austin Technology** | Microsoft-first automation integrated with managed IT and security | Delivers **Copilot Studio agents**, Power Automate workflows, document and email processing, business-system integrations, governance, training and support. It is based in Subiaco and supports more than 300 organisations nationally.[1] |
| **Frontrow Technology** | Applied Microsoft AI and production-grade agents | Focuses on Microsoft 365 Copilot readiness, **Copilot Studio agents**, Azure AI Foundry, RAG, multi-agent workflows, monitoring and governance for Perth mid-market businesses.[5] |
| **Ultron Developments** | Technical custom-agent engineering and complex integrations | Builds Copilot Studio agents and extensions connected to Dataverse, SharePoint, SAP and REST APIs, alongside Power Automate workflow automation and Azure-based AI architecture.[3][6] |
| **CG Tech** | Practical transformation for 50–500 employee organisations | Offers AI roadmaps, governance, Microsoft 365 and Copilot, Power Platform automation, custom agents, data and reporting work, with Perth delivery available onsite or remotely.[4] |
| **Ential** | Copilot adoption, training and governed internal agents | Builds custom Copilot Studio agents grounded in SharePoint and business data, while emphasising role-based adoption, permissions and governance for Western Australian businesses.[7] |
| **Scalify** | Focused Copilot Studio builds without forcing an AI solution | Develops Copilot Studio agents from Perth, but also builds custom AI teams, chat and voice systems where Copilot Studio is not the right fit.[10] |
| **Res-Q IT** | Smaller-business practical automation and honest tool selection | Provides Copilot adoption, workflow automation, integrations and self-hosted n8n solutions; explicitly distinguishes between tasks suited to AI and those better handled by deterministic automation.[8] |

### Strongest shortlist

- **TechBrain** — strongest match if the requirement is a managed service covering agent design, deployment, governance and ongoing operation.[2]
- **Austin Technology** — strong option where Microsoft 365, security, IT support and automation need to come from one Perth-based provider.[1]
- **Frontrow Technology** — suitable for more technical or production-oriented Copilot Studio and Azure AI work.[5]
- **Ultron Developments** — worth considering for complex enterprise integrations, custom APIs, Dataverse, SAP or industrial workflows.[3][6]
- **CG Tech** — a good fit for a 50–500-person organisation wanting practical transformation rather than an experimental AI project.[4]

For an initial conversation, ask each provider to demonstrate one complete workflow—such as inbound-email triage, document extraction, approval routing or internal policy support—with **human review, permissions, auditability, exception handling and a measurable business outcome** included from the outset.
